name: acme-partner-access-path-a3-r2
description: Partner HTTPS access path with edge source-NAT, mapped onto the live lab: ceos1 is the edge policy hop (partner ACL + SNAT pool selection), a LocalStack security group is the dmz segmentation hop, ceos2 is the core policy hop. The edge hop translates the partner CIDR to a NAT pool it SELECTS at design time from free addresses in the fabric's 10.99.0.0/24 allocation pool (existing allocations are scattered and discoverable ONLY by harvesting the live devices). The dmz and core hops must match that POST-NAT pool — a value that does not exist until the edge design runs. That makes the interdependency runtime: the three pipelines are DAG-sequenced (edge -> dmz -> core) and each downstream leg chains the upstream leg's actual deliverable. R2 (2026-08-21): the lab now exposes BINDABLE policy ports — A3.1's reviewer correctly blocked on 'no partner-facing interface exists on ceos1' (the untrust zone was notional). Ethernet2/Ethernet3 added on both switches with role descriptions; bind ACLs to these.
path: partner-internet -> ceos1(edge, SNAT) -> dmz-sg(LocalStack) -> ceos2(core) -> internal-app

nodes.name: ceos1
nodes.role: edge policy hop: partner-facing ACL + source-NAT pool selection

sourceNat.toPool: RUNTIME — a free /30 or /31 SELECTED by the edge design from the 10.99.0.0/24 pool after harvesting the live allocations on both switches; must not collide with ANY existing allocation
sourceNat.consequence: dmz-sg and ceos2 must match the POST-NAT pool, never the partner CIDR

policyInterfaces.Ethernet3: PARTNER-UPLINK (untrust zone) — bind the partner ingress ACL here

nodes.name: dmz-sg
nodes.role: dmz segmentation: ingress restricted to the POST-NAT pool
nodes.matches: POST-NAT pool (chained from the ceos1 leg's deliverable), NOT 203.0.113.0/24

nodes.name: ceos2
nodes.matches: POST-NAT pool (chained transitively via the dmz leg), NOT 203.0.113.0/24

policyInterfaces.Ethernet2: DMZ-SEGMENT (dmz zone) — bind the dmz->inside ACL here

links.routing: EXISTING eBGP 65001<->65002 — out of scope, do not modify

endToEndFlow.postNatSource: RUNTIME — the pool the edge design selects; dmz and core match THIS

interdependency.whyNotContract: the NAT pool is selected from addresses that are FREE in 10.99.0.0/24 at design time, discoverable only by harvesting the live devices — it is an OUTPUT of the edge design, not a value any Architect can agree up front. If it could be pre-agreed this would be the parallel shape.
